trans-unit.source: You decided to train a model with the current configuration. As an effect, all options to edit the configuration have been temporarily removed or disabled to make sure the configuration you see is the same configuration the model uses. If you want to make changes to your configuration, you need to discard the current model first. If you discard your model, you can again perform any changes and train a new model based on the new configuration.
trans-unit.target: Anda memilih untuk melatih model menggunakan konfigurasi semasa. Pilihan penyuntingan disembunyikan atau dinyahdayakan buat sementara waktu supaya konfigurasi yang dipaparkan sepadan dengan konfigurasi model. Untuk membuat perubahan, buang model semasa dahulu. Anda kemudian boleh mengubah konfigurasi dan melatih model baharu menggunakannya.

trans-unit.source: Discards the model, which gains you back your editing capabilities
trans-unit.target: Buang model supaya anda boleh menyunting semula.

trans-unit.source: For val_..., the metric is calculated on the validation data set while for the data without val as a prefix the metric is calculated on the training data set. The metrics for the validation data set can be seen as more meaningful since this is the data the network does not 'know'.

trans-unit.source: This tour will guide you through creating your own data set in a few simple steps. Everything is stored automatically, so you can close this modal at any time and resume.

trans-unit.source: General info about the data set
Choose a short but meaningful name for your data set and write a description.
trans-unit.target: Pilih nama ringkas dan bermakna untuk set data, kemudian tulis huraian.

trans-unit.source: Choose 'regression' if you want to predict continous values like house or gas prices
trans-unit.target: Pilih «regresi» jika anda mahu meramalkan nilai berterusan seperti harga rumah atau petrol.

trans-unit.source: Choose 'classification' if you want information about the affiliation of the feature(s) to a class (e.g. what animal can be seen in this image? A dog, cat or horse?)
trans-unit.target: Pilih «pengelasan» jika anda mahu mengetahui kelas bagi sesuatu ciri. Contohnya, adakah imej itu menunjukkan anjing, kucing atau kuda?

trans-unit.source: Which data will be put into the neural network? Create arbitrary many features!
trans-unit.target: Apakah data yang akan dimasukkan ke dalam rangkaian neural? Cipta sebanyak mana ciri yang anda mahu.

trans-unit.source: What shall be the output of the network?
Animal was detected as a horse
Now add your data in the following format
trans-unit.target: Sekarang tambah data anda dalam format berikut.

trans-unit.source: Each row needs to represent one set containing the features and the label. Seperate items with a comma (spaces before and after the comma are okay). The single last item always represents the label while the items before it represent the features. Make sure to use only dots and no commas for floating point values. If you have data in CSV format, you can just paste it here but make sure to remove any comments.
trans-unit.target: Setiap baris mewakili satu sampel yang mengandungi ciri dan label. Asingkan nilai dengan koma. Ruang sebelum atau selepas koma dibenarkan. Nilai terakhir sentiasa merupakan label, manakala nilai sebelumnya ialah ciri. Gunakan titik sahaja bagi nombor perpuluhan. Jika anda mempunyai data CSV, tampalkan di sini selepas membuang komen.

trans-unit.source: A dense layer, also called fully-connected layer, is a layer whose inside neurons connect to every neuron in the preceding layer.
trans-unit.target: Lapisan padat, juga dikenali sebagai lapisan bersambung sepenuhnya, menyambungkan setiap neuronnya kepada semua neuron dalam lapisan sebelumnya.

trans-unit.source: was deleted because no data could be assigned to it!
trans-unit.target: telah dipadam kerana tiada data dapat ditugaskan kepadanya!

trans-unit.source: An input layer is a layer that just takes data provided from outside the network and passes it on to the next layer(s)
trans-unit.target: Lapisan input menerima data dari luar rangkaian dan menghantarnya ke lapisan seterusnya.

trans-unit.source: The selected layer can not be duplicated! Only a single output layer is currently supported!
trans-unit.target: Lapisan yang dipilih tidak boleh diduplikasi! Buat masa ini hanya satu lapisan output disokong.

trans-unit.source: An output layer in this simulation is just a normal dense layer, additionally equipped with the ability to output the incoming data out of the network.
trans-unit.target: Dalam simulasi ini, lapisan output ialah lapisan padat biasa yang juga dapat mengeluarkan data masuk daripada rangkaian.

trans-unit.source: Since the purpose if this layer is to output a classifiction, we should combine it with a softmax activation function in order to provide a probability distribution.
trans-unit.target: Oleh sebab lapisan ini menghasilkan pengelasan, gunakan fungsi pengaktifan softmax untuk mendapatkan taburan kebarangkalian.

trans-unit.source: The Pima Indians Diabetes data set involves predicting the onset of diabetes within 5 years in Pima Indians given medical details. It is a binary (2-class) classification problem. The number of observations for each class is not balanced. There are 768 observations with 8 input variables and 1 output variable. Missing values are believed to be encoded with zero values.
trans-unit.target: Set data ini meramalkan permulaan diabetes dalam tempoh lima tahun dalam kalangan masyarakat Pima berdasarkan butiran perubatan. Ini ialah masalah pengelasan binari dengan bilangan pemerhatian yang tidak seimbang antara dua kelas. Terdapat 768 pemerhatian, 8 pemboleh ubah input dan 1 pemboleh ubah output. Nilai yang tiada dipercayai dikodkan sebagai sifar.

trans-unit.source: Why are some important options not editable or completely missing?
trans-unit.target: Mengapakah sesetengah pilihan penting tidak boleh disunting atau tidak kelihatan?

trans-unit.source: Many options are uneditable after you started a training to make sure what you see is actually what got translated into the model. To be able to edit everything again, just use the option to reset the model. After you performed your desired changes, you can then train a new model that respects them. If there is no trained model and you are missing options, most likely your teacher has disabled them for you.
trans-unit.target: Selepas latihan bermula, banyak pilihan dikunci supaya paparan sepadan dengan konfigurasi model. Set semula model untuk menyunting semuanya sekali lagi. Selepas perubahan, anda boleh melatih model baharu berdasarkan konfigurasi itu. Jika tiada model terlatih tetapi pilihan masih tidak kelihatan, guru anda mungkin telah menyahdayakannya.
